Commentary.Commentary: 322 to win for Bangladesh. The pitch does have extra bounce and that might help the West Indies bowlers. Bangladesh though, will aim to keep wickets in hand in Powerplay 1 and try to plan the run chase nicely.  Jason Holder would want a win to celebrate his 100th ODI. Let's hope for a good chase.

Shai Hope is down for a chat with Simon Doull. He says he started off a bit slow as he needed time to get in and he is still pleased with the score they have on the board. States they have more pace and height and Hope hopes they can extract more from the surface. Wants his bowlers to take early wickets. Mentions Hetmyer and Holder are very good players and they provided the much-needed impetus.

Bangladesh's bowling was good in patches. They started well but when the wickets were not coming, they began to lose a bit of patience. However, they brought it back in the end and choked the Windies. Mustafizur was sensational in his final 4 overs, going for just 18, after conceding 41 in his first 5. His double-wicket over consisting the scalps of Hetmyer and Russell can be called as a momentum-shifting over. Saifuddin helped himself to 3 wickets as well while captain Mortaza bowled only 8 overs. In fact, there was so much rotation of bowling, that only Saifuddin bowled his full quota of 10 overs!

32/1 in Powerplay 1. Too slow? But that is the norm in this World Cup, with the template being set by India. See off the first 10 overs, then accelerate in a sensible manner, giving your hitters the right number of overs at the death. West Indies lost Gayle early but the middle order played very well today. The second, third and fourth wickets added 236 in 217 balls and with the score reading 242/3 in the 40th over, 350 looked to be on the cards. But Hetmyer's wicket stalled proceedings slightly and the West Indies just about crossed 320.

Hmmm... tough question. Which side will be happier at the moment? West Indies started slowly, then began to compensate, lost their way, got a couple of cameos, lost their way again but in the end, finished strongly. 321 is a good score but Bangladesh will feel they can chase it down.

OUT! BOWLED! Corker of a yorker and Saifuddin ends his spell with a wicket. It is a slower ball, at 126 kph, Bravo is early into his swing and misses. The Zing bails illuminate. WEST INDIES FINISH ON 321/8!
Well outside off, crosses the wide guideline and Bravo lets it go. But the umpire does not signal a wide and Bravo is rightly not happy. Shakes his head.
Full and outside off, driven through point. Bravo does not take the single.
SIX! SLAP! A short ball, around off, Bravo pulls it over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep leaps but the ball sails over his head!
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
WIDE. Another wide. Outside off again.
WIDE. A slower bouncer, goes well over the batsman.
Full and around off, swinging in, Oshane swings hard but gets a thick inside edge. The ball bounces, hits the pad and lobs back to the bowler who dives forward and takes it.
WIDE. Well wide outside off, left alone.
A full ball, whipped wide of long on for a run. Just 6 from the over and the Fizz finishes with figures of 9-0-59-3.

NOT OUT. The bat has hit the stumps but it is after the shot has been completed. Full and outside off, Thomas swung hard but missed. The crowd gets excited with the bails down and the umpires discuss and refer it upstairs for the hit wicket appeal. However, replays show that Thomas has completed his shot and then, in the followthrough, the willow comes down and hits the stumps.
Is that a hit wicket? Looks like Thomas has hit the stumps with his bat. Referred upstairs...
Full on middle, Thomas whips it towards mid-wicket. Should have been just a single but Soumya Sarkar running to his right fumbles and concedes the second.
Pushes this through long on for one.
A full toss, on the stumps, flicked through square leg for a run.
Perfect delivery, a yorker outside off, Thomas swings hard but misses.
WIDE. A short ball, well outside off, Thomas backs away looking to pull but is too far from the ball. Does not matter though, as it is wided for height.

SIX! Little Bravo goes big! A boundary after 27 balls. Right in the slot as Saifuddin misses the yorker, goes full, gets it right under the bat and Bravo goes boom. Swings it over long on! Just 8 from that over, inspite of that six.
WIDE. Full and miles outside off, left alone.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Pushes this down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, hit straight to cover.
Full and down the leg side, Oshane misses his tickle. Now wide signalled. Did that hit the pad?
Outside off, a yorker, Thomas looks to drive it through the off side but misses.
Oshane Thomas walks in at number 9, replacing Hope.

OUT! Caught! No century for Hope! That is such a sad, sad thing for him! Played so well for so long, got stranded of partners and eventually, neither could he bat through, nor get his century. It is the best ball in the tournament or in ODIs of late. The full toss. An easy put away, that too, on the pads and Hope puts it away as well. But straight to deep backward square leg where Liton Das takes it easily! This is turning out to be a very good finish for Bangladesh.
Outside off, Hope swings hard but misses.
Fine yorker on middle, dug out back to the leg side for a single.

Full and outside off, Hope looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes through third man but Saifuddin dives full length to his left and partially stops the ball. The batsmen take a run.
A short ball, around middle, coming in with the angle, Bravo plays a Nataraja pull shot through fine leg for a single.
A bouncer outside off, slower in pace, Bravo lets that pass.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. 7-0-50-2 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for another couple. The boundaries are not getting found here.
Full and outside off, Hope drives it straight back. Saifuddin sticks out his right hand and stops the ball.
Down the leg side, helped through mid-wicket for another single.
On middle and leg, flicked away for one more.
Full and around off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
Full and outside off, chipped down to long off for another single. Not a bad gamble. Just 5 runs from that over.
Short and outside off, cut through point for one.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off to move into the 90s with that single.
Punches this through the off side for a quick run.
Around off, coming in, Bravo taps it towards point and sets off for a run but Hope sends him back. Bravo is not happy.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Gamble. Spinner in the 45th over. Mehedi Hasan is given the ball. 8-0-52-0 so far.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. One run added to the total. 9 runs and a wicket from the over, Saifuddin's figures read 7-1-48-2.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Darren Bravo walks in at number 8, replacing his skipper. Can he channel his CPL exploits?

OUT! Caught! Holder departs and this could dent the total big time. A full toss, around middle and leg, Holder looks to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball goes high in the air and Mahmudullah takes it calmly at long off. A cameo from Holder but his team needed more from him.
WIDE. Well outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, driven towards long on for a brace.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Holder backs away and pummels it over the bowler towards long off!
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin returns. 6-1-39-1 so far.
Works this off his pads for a run. 13 from the over.
Holder flicks this off his pads to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Almost a catch! Should he have stayed back and stopped the boundary instead of going for the catch? FOUR! Just short for the fielder at long on. Holder again lofts this length delivery from Mortaza to long on off the toe end of his bat. The fielder was in two minds whether to go for the the catch or save the boundary. He starts late and dives in front but the ball bounces  in front of the fielder and runs away to the fence.

SIX! Up, up and away! Captain dismisses captain over long on!  Thats's humongous from Holder. What he couldn't do in the previous delivery he does it this time. Mortaza bowls on a length and Holder lofts it straight and over the long on fence for a 105- metre Maximum.
Mortaza bowls this one  short and outside off, Holder looks to pull it but can only drag it to mid on.
Outside off, Hope punches it towards cover and takes a quick single.
Mashrafe Mortaza brings himself back on. Perfect stage to take control. Get Holder and perhaps even 300 could be difficult. 7-1-24-0 so far.
FOUR! Another short ball, Holder stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A bouncer on middle, JH looks to pull but then bails out at the last moment. He looks at the square leg umpire for a wide call but does not get it.
Full and outside off, Jason looks to go inside out but skews it. A top edge is induced but it lands in no man's land. By the time long off can get around to his left, two runs are taken.
A short ball, around middle, angling away, Holder looks to pull but is beaten by the lack of pace. Is hit on the right shoulder and the ball lobs towards point.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Holder plays it sensibly here. He just comes on the front foot and plays this tossed up ball into the ground.

FOUR! What an intent from the captain He realizes that there is less time left in this innings and starts on an attacking mode. First six now a boundary. Holder drives this tossed up delivery through covers and the ball reaches away to the fence in a flash. 10 runs from 2 balls.
SIX! Up and over mid on!  What a way to get going in your 100th ODI. Holder just gets under this  tossed up delivery from Shakib and smokes it to long on.
Hope this time runs this down to point for a quick single.
This time Hope pushes this flatter one to mid off.
Hope slaps this fuller one straight to short cover.
POWERPLAY 3 time and Jason Holder comes out as well. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end. Shakib Al Hasan is back on too.

OUT! Caught behind! This time, there is a nick and Russell departs for a blob! Similar ball as the previous one. This is the cutter as well, pitched outside leg but this one has extra bounce. Russell looks to defend but the ball zips away, takes the outside edge and Rahim completes the formalities after diving to his right. Mustafizur completes the formalities of appealing as well, as per the norm. Does not want to get penalized by Glenn McGrath who was penalzied by umpire Hanumant Singh sometime in the early 2000s for not appealing. What an over - 3 runs and 2 wickets! Momentum-shifting?

Appeal for a caught behind! Nothing in it. Fizz himself is unsure. Mustafizur wants a review but Mortaza turns it down. On a length around middle and leg, Russell looks to defend but the ball seams away after pitching and just misses the outside edge. Ultra Edge shows it hit nothing.
A length ball, Hope looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses. Mustafizur appeals for LBW but that seemed to be pitching outside leg. The ball goes towards third man and a leg bye is taken.
Butcher time! Andre Russell strides out. The stage is perfectly set. 63 balls left. The target is 350. Ready to load his weapon of mass destruction.

OUT! Taken in the deep! Hetmyer falls after a whirlwind knock. His innings has given the West Indies some much-needed impetus. It is another cutter from the Fizz but Shimron does not pick it. He is early into his slog and gets a top edge. The ball swirls in the air but Tamim Iqbal running to his right from deep mid-wicket keeps his eyes on the ball and takes it with a good dive.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

LEADING EDGE, SAFE! Half century for Hetmyer. In just 25 balls. Joint fastest of this World Cup, along with Alex Carey who got that against India. A length ball, the cutter, pitched in line of the stumps, Shimron looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It is in the air but wide of mid off. A single taken.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. 5-0-41-0 so far. Can he do well in the death overs?
Hetmyer comes down the track to loft this flatter one but can only get it off  the toe end towards long off for a single. 6 singles in the over.
Hope flicks this fuller one on the pads to mid-wicket for a single.
Hetmyer slaps this fuller one outside off  through covers for a run.
Hope pushes this flatter one to mid on for a single.
Hetmyer slaps this flatter one outside off to covers for a single.
Bowls a tossed up delivery on the pads, Hope works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle, hit down towards long on for a couple. 14 from this one as well, make it 60 from the last 4.
Full and down the leg side, SH looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Outside off, Shimron rocks back and looks to punch but the ball comes back in, cramps him for room and takes the bottom edge, enroute the bowler.
Looks like the ball has been lost. The box of replacement balls comes out.

SIX! That is 104 metres on the radar and it is the biggest one of the tournament! Beats Russell's 103 metre one against Australia. Short and around middle, Hetmyer rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket!

MISFIELD NOW. Pressure is on Bangladesh and they are not responding well. Around off, Shimron pulls this towards square leg. Mashrafe Mortaza gets across to his right and it should have been a regulation stop but he fumbles and lets it through. What should been a dot becomes a couple.
FOUR! Another boundary. Short and outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it through point.
Mosaddek Hossain returns. 5-0-22-0 so far.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. 10 from the over, 46 off the last 3!
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short again, cut again, this time for a single.
FOUR! The boundaries are leaking now. 5th off the bat in the space of 23 balls. Short and outside off, Hetmyer rocks back and cuts it through point.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a couple.
Mehedi Hasan is back on. 6-0-36-0 so far.

SIX! Hetmyer is bringing it on. Full and on middle, Shimron gets down and slogs it massively over mid-wicket! 17 from the over, 36 from the last 2! My colleague Shlok just mentioned by mistake at the start of this over that West Indies would target 80 runs in overs 36-40. Is his voice revelling in Taunton?
Nice comeback. Fires in a yorker on middle, dug out back to the bowler.
SIX! SLAM! A short ball, around middle and leg, Hetmyer swivels and pulls it over backward square leg!
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a brace again.
On a length around off, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Hetmyer works this length delivery off his pads to mid-wicket for a couple.

RUN OUT MISSED! Everything happening in this over. Hope plays this length delivery outside off to short third man and sets off for a run. Hetmyer from the other end comes halfway down the pitch and stops. There is slight confusion between Hope and Hetmyer in the middle. Saifuddin picks up the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses it. Had he hit Hetmyer would have been a goner. But in the end they get a single though a risky one at this stage of the game.
Hope taps this length delivery outside off towards point.
WIDE. Mustafizur sprays one down leg and Hope misses on his flick, the umpire calls it  a wide.

FIVE WIDES! This is a bonus. Bouncer, well over everyone. Mustafizur bowls a short one but the ball shoots up from that length and keeps on rising and rising to beat the jump of the keeper and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Hope this time pulls this short ball handsomely to deep square leg for  one bounce into the fence.
SIX! Up and over long off!  Quite aggressive from Hope. Rahman bowls one on a length and Hope puts on his dancing shoes to loft this through the line over long off for a maximum.
Around off, on a length, Hope defends solidly.
Mustafizur Rahman returns. 4-0-22-0 so far.
Landed outside off, SH cuts it through point where Mehedi Hasan makes a good stop to his right.
Around off, coming in, worked through square leg for one more.
Around middle and off, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The off cutter, good change of pace, pitched around leg and middle, SH waits for the ball to come to him and guides it towards third man for a single.
Nice comeback, a yorker on middle, Shimron digs it out back to the bowler.
FOUR! That is a cracking shot. Short ball, around middle and leg, Hetmyer pulls it through mid-wicket.
Works it through the leg side for a quick run. 8 runs and a wicket from the over, Shakib's figures read 7-0-43-2.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Shakib is persisting to the leg stump line and Hetmyer this time sweeps and sweeps fine. He connects it superbly to fetch a boundary to fine leg.
Shakib again bowls a delivery going down leg and this time Hetmyer lofts it into the gap at mid-wicket and gets a couple. He gets off the mark.
Shakib bowls one down the leg side, Hetmyer looks to whack that out of the park but can only get it of his pads, towards the leg side and they steal a leg bye.

DRINKS BREAK! Just when West Indies look to get ahead with the scoring rate, they get pegged back. The good thing is that Shai Hope is still there and they need him to bat through. SHIMRON HETMYER walks in at number 5, replacing Pooran.

OUT! In the air... taken! Pooran holes out. He walks back after getting off to a start. A good wicket for Bangladesh as he was looking good and has also been in form. Nothing wrong with him playing this shot to be honest, it was in his arc. Full and on middle, Pooran goes down on one knee and looks to clear the long on fence but his bat turns in his hands due to which he does not get the timing he would have liked. There is more height than distance on it and Sarkar at long on takes a good catch. Bangladesh once again get a timely wicket due to which the Windies are not able to get ahead in this game.
Hope makes room and looks to go inside out over covers. Does not get the desired connection and it goes towards long off for one.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Around middle and off, coming in, tucked through square leg for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, Pooran slashes hard, looking to drive but misses.
Mohammad Saifuddin back into the attack. 3-1-12-1 so far.
Hope comes on the front foot to his full ball and bunts it into the ground.

MIX-UP, SAFE! OHH! Some confusion. Pooran wristily flicks this full ball on the pads to long on and runs through to the other side.  Pooran looks to come back for a second and is half way down but doesn't get any response from his partner. In the end all is well as he makes his ground back towards the bowler's end before the throw arrives.
Hope punches this flatter one on the stumps through covers for a single.
Down the leg side, paddled fine for a run. The ball hits the toe end of the bat and goes off the keeper's pads towards short fine leg. A run taken.
Hope punches this flatter one on stumps to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Pooran eases this to long on for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed to the off side for a quick run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
New ball please. Seems like the ball has been damaged from the previous hit. The umpires are getting it replaced.
SIX! On the roof! Pooran's intentions are clear. Attack the spinners. Full and outside off, nicely tossed up, Pooran gets under the ball and lofts it as clean as a whistle over long off, on the roof!

Good football skills. Full and around off, coming in with the angle, Pooran backs away and lofts this over the bowler. Mosaddek runs a long way to his left from long off and kicks the ball in play just before it is about to touch the ropes. Long on mops it up. Two runs taken.
Shakib bowls one outside off, Hope pushes it to covers.
Pooran flicks this full ball on pads to long on and crosses over to the other end.
Pooran sweeps again this time but finds square leg to perfection.
Hope pushes this tossed up delivery on the stumps to long off for a run.
Hope pushes this flatter one outside off to covers.
Full on the pads, Pooran plays the sweep to backward square leg  for a run.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for one more.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Nice shot. Tossed up outside off, Pooran leans and drives it through the covers!
WIDE. Down the leg side, Pooran looks to flick but misses. Loses balance but is fine.

Half century for Shai Hope now. His 12th in this format. Before entering this game, Shai was averaging in the 90s against Bangladesh. Adds more runs to his tally. Gets there with a push through point for a run.
Full on middle, driven down the ground. Saifuddin covers good ground to his left from long on, dives and stops the boundary. Two runs taken.
Full and around off, well defended.
Mehedi Hasan is back on. 4-0-18-0 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, driven through the covers for a single.
Hossain bowls one short and Hope rocks back to pull this through mid-wicket. A run is added to the total.
Pooran punches this flatter one off the back foot.
Flatter and outside off, Pooran pushes it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Hossain bowls one short and Pooran rocks back to cut that through point for a boundary.
Floated on leg, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket. 8 runs but a wicket as well from the over.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Tossed up outside off, Pooran slashes hard, looking to play a cover drive but misses.
Nicholas Pooran comes in at number 4, replacing Lewis.

OUT! Caught in the deep! No century for Lewis and the Bangladeshis have broken through. The 116-stand is cut short. West Indies are reaching a stage where the run rate needs to be upped a little. That is what Lewis might have thought. Looks to go big, aiming to clear long off, but this one hits the bottom part of his bat. He ends up finding Sabbir Rahman, the substitute at long off. Looks unhappy with himself and trudges off. Shakib was not bowling that well today and hence Lewis may have targetted him. But eventually, Shakib has the last laugh.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple more.
SIX! SLAM! Full and outside off, Lewis gets down and sweeps it massively over mid-wicket! That is the longest part of the boundary.
Punches this through the covers for one more.
Punches this towards long on for another single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for another single.
Around off, pushed through mid on for one more.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Full and on middle, punched back to the bowler. Hossain leaps to his right but the ball bursts through his fingers past mid off. A single taken.
FOUR! In the air but safe. Short and outside off, Lewis cuts this uppishly through the covers and gets a boundary. 14 from the over!
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside leg, Lewis gently paddles it past the keeper to the fine leg fence!
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
Pushes this through mid on for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point. The fielder races to his left from cover and slides, stopping the boundary. Three runs taken.
HALF CENTURY FOR LEWIS! A 50-plus score after a year. Gets there with a punch through the covers.
Down the leg side, worked through the leg side for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Around middle, worked through the leg side for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan comes on to bowl. Bangladesh have finally gone to their main man for wickets.
Flatter and on the stumps, it is defended.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller on off, this is stroked through the off side for one.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Well fielded! This is creamed through the covers. Mahmuduallah runs to his right, slides and saves two for his side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Gloved and a boundary! Poor delivery! Short and down the leg side, Lewis looks to pull but gets it off his glove and it races to the fine leg fence.
Cramps the batsman for room by bowling it on his body. It is blocked out.
Another back of a length delivery, Hope stands tall and pushes it through covers for one.
Well stopped! Down the leg side, Lewis works it towards the left of short fine leg. Saifuddin gets to the ball quickly and saves three for his side.
Very full and on off, Hope strokes it nicely through covers for one.
This is on the pads, Hope looks to flick but is beaten for pace. Gets hit on the thigh pad.
Just the single from Hossain's first. Full and on off, this is eased down to long off for one.

Hossain gets away with  one there. This is short and on middle, Hope goes back and pulls it but towards square leg who makes a good stop diving to his right. Just needed to beat that fielder and it would have been a boundary.
Flatter and on the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off, Hope goes back and pushes it to covers.
Very full and on middle, this is jammed out to the bowler.
This is on the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Mosaddek Hossain is on now! He has a knack of picking wickets and Bangladesh need one here.
On the off pole, Lewis pushes it to mid off. So just the two singles from the over.
An off cutter on off, Lewis keeps it out.
Back of a length on off, Hope stands tall and pushes it through covers for one.
Goes full, looking to hit the pads of Hope. The batter gets his bat down in time and works it to mid-wicket.
Good length and on off, Hope guides it to point.
That has been creamed but towards sweeper cover. Full and outside off, this is hit hard through covers for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap. Not a bad ball. It is fractionally short of full but Hope picks the length in a trice, goes back and punches it through the covers. No soul in the deep.
Around middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Short ball, around middle and leg, Lewis swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. Tamim Iqbal gets across to his right from short fine leg and tumbles, keeping the batsmen to a single.
Landed outside off, driven straight to cover.

This is taking longer than expected. Mosaddek seems to be wanting his left wrist checked and the umpires have taken this opportunity to call for a Drinks Break. Bangladesh have done well so far, they have not let West Indies score freely and have also got the big fish. However, after the early wicket the Windies have managed to fightback with the likes of Lewis and Hope. The two started off slowly but have upped the ante now. West Indies would hope the two could continue whereas, Bangladesh would want to break this stand as quickly as possible.

Tossed up outside off, Lewis drives this through the covers. Mosaddek Hossain covers good ground to his right and slides to stop the ball but while doing so, gets hurt. He is not comfortable and is on his haunches and calls for the physio. Shakib comes and checks on him as well. Meanwhile, the batsmen take a couple.
Around off, Hope goes back and works it wide of mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, played beautifully through the covers but there is protection at sweeper. Just a single.
Outside off, coming around the wicket, tapped watchfully towards cover.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Down the leg side once more. Lewis misses his clip and they take a leg bye.
WIDE. A wild bouncer, down the leg side, ducked under.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a single.

Another LBW appeal! Now Mustafizur wants a review! Looks like Bangladesh are getting carried away here. This is pitched on a good length around off and seams in off the deck. Hope is hit on the pads in his attempt to flick and up goes the Fizz. Replays detect an inside edge as well.
The Fizz returns. 1-0-8-0 so far. Needs to get into some sort of a rhythm here.

Huge shout for LBW, turned down! Mortaza talks long and hard with Mehedi and Rahim but eventually does not take it. It seemed to be pitching outside leg and hitting outside leg as well. Lewis looked to sweep and the ball went off something towards fine leg. The reason we are saying 'something' is because the umpire has signalled as runs. Looked like it hit the pads though. Two taken. Here come the replays. Pitched on leg stump, going down leg, but missing the bat.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, worked through square leg for one.
Short again, this is cut past point for a run.
Short and outside off, Lewis misses out, cutting the ball straight to point.
Around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, steered through third man for a run.
Outside off, punched through the covers for one more.
FOUR! PUMMELED! Lewis is slowly opening up now. A short ball, outside off, begging to be hit, Lewis camps back and pulls it over mid-wicket, one bounce and into the fence!
This one angles in a long way from outside off, Hope looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batsmen scamper a leg bye.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Landed outside off, defended stoutly.
Around off, blocked out to the off side.
Full and tossed up outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Landed outside off, played through point for one.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Tossed up around off, Lewis pushes this back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. Two runs added to the total. The umpire signals leg byes.
SIX! There comes the first counter-punch. Full and outside off, Lewis spots the slower ball, 128 kph, waits for it and lofts it nonchalantly over long off!
Punches this off the back foot for a quick run.

Landed outside off, the cutter, Hope looks to work it to the leg side but is early into the shot and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls behind and the batsmen initially want the single but then change their mind.
POWERPLAY 2 signalled. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. 32/1 for West Indies in Powerplay 1, it clearly has been their opponent's Powerplay.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for an easy single.
Full and around off, well blocked out.
Landed in line of the off stump, defended from the crease.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers where Shakib makes a half stop.
Spin time. Mehedi Hasan into the attack.
Around off, this one comes in as well, cramps Hope for room but he adjusts well and taps it towards point.
Outside off, coming in, played straight to point.
Around off, pushed towards mid on.
Works it wide of mid on for a quick run.
Outside off, Lewis looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
A length ball down the leg side, tucked through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Solid, solid stroke from Hope. Spoils the over and makes it a good one for West Indies. Back of a length on off, Hope stands tall and pushes it off the back foot through covers for a boundary.
Once again, he gets the ball to come back in but once again it is on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Well bowled and well played! Back of a length and it is angled away from the batter. Hope stands tall and guides it down to third man for one.
A little too straight again, Lewis works it towards mid on and takes one. Rahman is getting the ball to come back in but he needs to start from outside off.
Good shot but for no runs! Fuller and tailing back in into the pads, Evin works it but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
This time it is down the leg side, Lewis looks to flick it but misses. Wided.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack now. He has been the gun bowler for Bangladesh in this tournament. Can he get another scalp for them here?
A single to end the 7th over. This is on the pads, Lewis works it towards wide mid on and takes one.
Length again on off, Lewis strokes it on the up but finds cover-point.
Back of a length and around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On the off pole again, Hope guides it to point.
On the pads this is worked through square leg for one.
Back of a length around off, Lewis pushes it to covers.

Just short! Good comeback by the bowler. He lands it on off and angles it away. Lewis plays it with an angled bat but gets an outside edge. It falls just short of the widish first slip fielder who gets a hand to it. The ball rolls to third man for one. 10 from the over, a much-needed good over for the Windies.
FOUR! Dispatched! Short and wide outside off, Lewis loves it there. He goes back and slaps it hard through point for a boundary. This is a good over for West Indies.
Another one on the middle pole, Hope works it to mid on and gets to the other end.
Close! A straighter line, Hope plants his front foot way too across but gets his bat down in time. Had he missed there, he would have been plumb LBW.

FOUR! Poor length and it has been put away! Not sure why Saifuddin went short. It won't trouble the batter at his pace. Hope goes back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence. First boundary for Hope.
Nicely driven but to mid off! Fuller in length and around off, Hope leans into it and strokes it to mid off. Saifuddin is still getting the ball to move here.

A leg bye to end the 5th over! This is on the pads, Hope looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls towards fine leg. Hope runs the first one very hard but has to settle for the single. Another tight over for Bangladesh.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batter. Hope works it to mid-wicket.
Good running! We will see this a lot more after Gayle's dismissal. This is on off, Lewis pushes it to mid off and a run is taken.
This is tight bowling! Continues bowling it on a length and around off, Lewis pushes it to mid off.
On the pads, Lewis works it to mid-wicket.
Good length and on off, Lewis pushes it to covers.
A dot to end a terrific over by Saifuddin, a wicket maiden. He lands it on off and gets it to shape away a little. Hope defends it onto the ground.
Uppish but well short! Fuller and on off, Hope drive it hard and uppishly but well short of mid off.
Another good delivery! Length and around of, Hope shoulders arms to this one.
Goes fuller and on off, Hope looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid off.
Shai Hope is the new man in. He has been exceptional this year. He needs to play another good knock for his side.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Saifuddin gets the big fish. Gayle is out of here without making an impact. A well-deserved wicket for MS and he set the batsman up beautifully. He kept bringing the ball back in till now and suddenly gets this one to angle across. The length and line are also perfect. He bowls it just around off. Gayle once again plays for the inswing which means he plays inside the line. The ball kisses the outside edge and goes low to the left of Rahim who takes a nice diving catch. Bangladesh are elated and this is the ideal start for them after electing to bowl.
Saifuddin goes full again, which is right at the moment as he is getting the ball to tail back in. Gayle hits it with the swing to mid-wicket.

Lewis would feel he missed out there! Shorter and outside off, Lewis looks to cut but ends up mistiming it to covers. It was a scoring opportunity there but Lewis missed out. So just the boundary from Mashrafe's second.
Once again it is angled into the off pole, Lewis lunges and defends it to covers.
Goes really wide outside off but inside the tramline. Lewis lets it be.
Almost chops it on! Mashrafe angles it into the off stump from around the wicket. Lewis looks to push it through the off side but away from his body. He gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! In the gap and it races to the boundary! First of the game! Back of a length around off, Lewis stands tall, plays it late and guides it through cover-point and the ball races away to the fence. Mashrafe was a touch shorter there and it is easy pickings at his pace.
Lovely bowling! This is fuller around off, Mashrafe angles it away from the batter. Lewis plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Another tidy over for Bangladesh comes to an end. Length and outside off, Gayle shoulders arms to it.
Well bowled! Starts this from outside off and then gets it to shape back in. Gayle initially looks to play it but then lets it be.

Goes fuller this time and the ball tails back in a touch. Gayle pushes it back to the bowler. Saifuddin gives the big man a stare. That could turn out to be a bad move as you don't want to get Gayle angry.
Cramps Gayle for room by bowling it on his body. Gayle defends it out.
Once again some swing for Saifuddin. He lands it on a length around middle, Gayle works it with the swing to the left of the bowler.
The idea was good but the execution was not there. Saifuddin goes for the inswinging yorker but the line is down the leg side. Rahim does well to dive to his right and stop it. Wide signaled.
West Indies are underway! Lewis strides forward and pushes it through covers for an easy run.
Mohammad Saifuddin to bowl from the other end, with the second new ball.
A maiden to begin with by Mashrafe! Another length ball and it is pitched on off, slanting away. Gayle shoulders arms to it.
Third leave of the over! Outside off and Gayle need not play at those.
Shorter in length and outside off, Gayle looks to cut but there is not a lot of width on offer. He ends up chopping it to the off side.
This time Mash makes Gayle play. Back of a length and around off, Gayle pushes it to covers.
Another good delivery! Length and around off, this one pitches and then shapes away. Gayle ends up playing inside the line and lets it go to the keeper.
Good delivery to begin with! Length around off and it is angled away. Gayle shoulders arms to it.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems. We are all set for the action to get underway. The West Indies openers, Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis make their way out to the middle. Chris Gayle will take strike and he will be facing Mashrafe Mortaza who has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
Both the teams are out for their respective National Anthems. It would be Bangladesh's first followed by the West Indian one.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Chris Gayle, Evin Lewis, Shai Hope (WK), Darren Bravo (IN FOR CARLOS BRATHWAITE), Nicholas Pooran, Shimron Hetmyer, Jason Holder (C), Andre Russell, Sheldon Cottrell, Oshane Thomas, Shannon Gabriel.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Liton Das (IN FOR MOHAMMAD MITHUN), Mahmudullah, Mosaddek Hossain, Mohammad Saifuddin, Mehedi Hasan, Mashrafe Mortaza (C), Mustafizur Rahman.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder, says he wanted to bowl too but now they have an opportunity to put up some runs. States they will have to face the first 10 overs carefully and then it should get easy. Admits they lacked intent against England but they are now eager to do well here. Informs they have one change, Bravo coming in for Brathwaite.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says there are some patches on the wicket. Mentions they are chasing well and hence, they want to bowl first. States they have been on and off, they have practiced hard in the last few days and are ready for this game. Informs there is one change, Liton Das comes in and Mithun sits out.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and elected to field.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Smith starts by saying, the weather is good and it is going to stay good and there is very less chance of rain. Mel Jones now giving the pitch report, says they have had two games on this ground and the wicket should have something for both the batters as well as bowlers. Mentions the batters need to be patient and once they get in, run scoring should be good. Ends by saying the spinners could be used with the new ball as well.

We are almost halfway through the tournament, we are now at a stage where all the teams will be keeping one eye on the points table. Today's game sees two teams who are eager for a victory. West Indies are taking on Bangladesh. The two sides head into this one after receiving a thumping from England. However, this looks to be a more interesting battle. Who will come out on top? We will have to wait and watch.
